subject.title: feat(subagents): add execution backend placement contract

question: Should OpenClaw publish an execution-placement config and model-facing `sessions_spawn.execution` API before there is a real non-local backend implementation and its isolation/lifecycle policy?
rationale: This is not a mechanical correctness choice: the answer determines whether the new config names, preview backend types, and model-facing placement object become supported compatibility commitments.

options.title: Pause the public placement contract
options.body: Defer this PR’s config and tool API until the canonical execution-backend work defines backend dispatch, isolation, lifecycle, and operator semantics.

options.title: Narrow to built-in local behavior
options.body: Remove named backend/profile configuration and non-local type names, retaining only behavior that has a concrete local execution effect.

options.title: Approve a preview contract deliberately
options.body: Accept the compatibility commitment now, but require the resolver to reject every non-`local` backend and document the preview boundary before merge.

recommendation.title: Pause the public placement contract
recommendation.body: Defer this PR’s config and tool API until the canonical execution-backend work defines backend dispatch, isolation, lifecycle, and operator semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history indicates the strongest connection to the shared sessions-spawn and subagent-runtime public surface affected by the contract choice.
